property.name: ranger.plugin.doris.policy.rest.url
property.description: specify ranger admin rest address, replace this value as like localhost:6080.

property.name: xasecure.doris.update.xapolicies.on.grant.revoke
property.description: Should Doris plugin update Ranger policies for updates to permissions done using GRANT/REVOKE?

property.name: ranger.admin.kerberos.keytab
property.description: specify ranger admin keytab path, replace this value as like /etc/security/keytabs/ranger.keytab.

property.name: ranger.admin.kerberos.principal
property.description: specify ranger admin principal, replace this value as like ranger/hostname@DOMAIN.
